entries.meaningZh: 泽泻浸出物〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The historian compared two old accounts of alismin without accepting their claims about its medicinal value.
entries.zh: 历史研究者比较了对泽泻浸出物的两种旧记述，没有采信其中关于其药用价值的宣称。

entries.en: The anatomist traced the alisphenoid margin on a drawing of the skull.
entries.zh: 解剖学家在颅骨图上描出了蝶骨大翼的边缘。

entries.en: Her review of the archived alizapride trial separated the results from the authors' speculation.
entries.zh: 她在评述那项存档的阿立必利试验时，把结果与作者的推测分开了。

entries.en: The chemist compared two old descriptions of alizaramide without repeating their preparation instructions.
entries.zh: 化学家比较了对茜酰胺的两种旧记述，没有复述其制备指引。

entries.en: The old chemistry chapter compared alkalamides with other compounds in its proposed classification.
entries.zh: 那一章旧化学教材在其提出的分类中，把碱胺类与其他化合物作了比较。

entries.en: The slight alkalescence of the water was noted before the samples were compared.
entries.zh: 在比较样本之前，水的微碱性已被记录下来。

entries.en: His account of the solution's alkalescency omitted the conditions of measurement.
entries.zh: 他对溶液微碱性的描述遗漏了测量条件。

entries.en: The reviewer asked which of the materials were alkalifiable under the stated conditions.
entries.zh: 审稿人问，哪些材料在所述条件下可以碱化。

entries.en: She compared the Alkaligenes isolates described in two historical microbiology papers.
entries.zh: 她比较了两篇历史微生物学论文中描述的产碱杆菌属分离株。

entries.en: The proposed alkaligenous action remained a question for the researchers, not an established result.
entries.zh: 所提出的生碱作用对研究人员而言仍是一个问题，而非已经确立的结果。

entries.en: The historian compared two early debates about alkalitherapy without endorsing either treatment.
entries.zh: 历史研究者比较了早期有关碱疗法的两场争论，并未认可其中任何一种治疗。

entries.en: The report compared alkalization in two soil samples collected from the same field.
entries.zh: 报告比较了取自同一片田地的两个土壤样本的碱化情况。

entries.en: The authors questioned the proposed alkalogenic effect on urine and called for further evidence.
entries.zh: 作者对所提出的使尿液呈碱性的作用提出质疑，并要求提供更多证据。

entries.en: The seminar examined how arguments for alkalotherapy had changed between the two old textbooks.
entries.zh: 研讨会考察了两本旧教科书中支持碱疗法的论据有何变化。

entries.en: The chemistry student compared the drawn structures of an alkamine and a simple alcohol.
entries.zh: 化学专业学生比较了图中一种氨基醇和一种简单醇的结构。

entries.en: The proposed molecule contained an alkanesulfonamide group, but its properties had not been measured.
entries.zh: 所提出的分子含有一个链烷磺酰胺基团，但其性质尚未测定。

entries.en: The restorer investigated the alkanin in an old dye sample before discussing the textile's colour.
entries.zh: 修复人员先研究了一份旧染料样品中的紫朱草素，然后讨论那件纺织品的颜色。

entries.en: The old herbarium's alkanna specimen had lost most of its flowers before the artist examined it.
entries.zh: 画家查看那家旧植物标本馆的紫朱草标本时，标本上的大部分花已经脱落。

entries.en: The conservator requested an analysis of the alkannin in the faded red textile.
entries.zh: 文物修复人员要求分析那件褪色红色纺织品中的紫草红。

entries.en: The student drew an alkanoate beside the alcohol used in her theoretical reaction scheme.
entries.zh: 学生在自己的理论反应图中，把一种链烷酸酯画在所用的醇旁边。

entries.en: The historian compared two early structural proposals for alkargen without reproducing a preparation method.
entries.zh: 历史研究者比较了对二甲胂酸结构的两种早期提议，没有复述制备方法。

entries.en: The tutor asked her to locate each double bond in the drawn alkatriene.
entries.zh: 导师让她找出图中链三烯的每一个双键。

entries.en: He revised the alkatriene diagram after noticing that the assignment required an alkatriyne instead.
entries.zh: 他发现作业要求的是链三炔，便修改了原先的链三烯结构图。

entries.en: The historian compared drawings of alkekengi fruits in two old dispensatories without adopting their medicinal advice.
entries.zh: 历史研究者比较了两本旧药物手册中的酸浆实图画，没有采纳其中的用药建议。

entries.en: The proposed molecular drawing placed an alkenoxy group beside the ring.
entries.zh: 拟议的分子结构图在环旁边画了一个链烯氧基。

entries.en: The diagram distinguished the alkenyl substituent from the saturated chain beside it.
entries.zh: 图中把链烯基取代基与其旁边的饱和链区分开来。

entries.en: The archived trial report discussed Alkeran, but the historian did not evaluate its clinical claims.
entries.zh: 存档的试验报告讨论了左旋苯丙氨酸氮芥，但历史研究者没有评价其临床说法。

entries.en: The old natural-history collection included a drawing of an alkermes beside its host leaf.
entries.zh: 那份旧博物学收藏中有一幅冬青虫及其寄主叶片的图画。

entries.en: The old chemistry exercise asked students to draw an alkine containing four carbon atoms.
entries.zh: 那道旧化学习题要求学生画出一种含四个碳原子的炔烃。

entries.en: We kept the damp sketches from Alkmaar away from the rest of our luggage.
entries.zh: 我们把来自阿尔克马尔的潮湿速写与其余行李分开放着。

entries.en: The reviewer found the published analysis of alkofanone incomplete and requested the missing spectra.
entries.zh: 审稿人认为已发表的氨磺苯丙酮分析不完整，要求提供缺失的光谱。

entries.en: The seminar compared two early translations of the Alkoran without quoting either one.
entries.zh: 研讨会比较了《可兰经》的两种早期译本，但没有引用其中任何一种。

entries.en: The examiner circled the alkoxy substituent that had been omitted from the student's drawing.
entries.zh: 考官圈出了学生在结构图中漏画的烷氧基取代基。

entries.en: Their draft compared two proposed routes of alkoxylation without reporting an experimental procedure.
entries.zh: 他们的草稿比较了两条拟议的烷氧基化途径，并未报告实验操作程序。

entries.en: The archive's account of Alkron sales was incomplete, so the researcher consulted the original ledgers.
entries.zh: 档案对对硫磷销售情况的记述不完整，因此研究者查阅了原始账簿。

entries.en: The tutor asked which nitrogen carried the substituent in the drawn alkyl-sulfamide.
entries.zh: 导师问，图中的N-烷基硫酸二酰胺是哪一个氮原子带有取代基。

entries.en: The review compared the published structures of several alkylaluminium compounds.
entries.zh: 这篇综述比较了几种烷基铝化合物已经发表的结构。

entries.en: The analyst could not identify the alkylate from the incomplete spectrum alone.
entries.zh: 分析人员无法仅凭那份不完整的光谱确定这种烷基化物的身份。

entries.en: The student explained why the proposed alkylation would change the structure shown in the diagram.
entries.zh: 学生解释了为什么所提出的烷基化会改变图示结构。

entries.en: The student compared an alkylisothiocyanate structure with the differently connected thiocyanate in the textbook.
entries.zh: 学生把一种异硫氰酸烷基酯的结构与教材中连接方式不同的硫氰酸酯作了比较。

entries.en: The chemist compared the proposed structures of several alkylolamides without describing their preparation.
entries.zh: 化学家比较了几种烷基醇酰胺的拟议结构，没有描述其制备方法。

entries.en: The student compared an alkylsulfonate salt with the ester drawn beside it.
entries.zh: 学生把一种烷基磺酸盐与其旁边画出的酯作了比较。

entries.en: She marked the triple bond and hydroxyl group in the alkynol structure.
entries.zh: 她在炔醇结构中标出了三键和羟基。

entries.en: He had already poured the All-Bran into a bowl when he noticed there was no milk.
entries.zh: 他已经把All-Bran麸皮麦片倒进碗里，才发现没有牛奶。

entries.meaningZh: 全部由加拿大人组成的
entries.en: The festival assembled an all-Canadian cast for its new production.
entries.zh: 艺术节为这部新制作集结了一个全部由加拿大人组成的演员阵容。

entries.en: The old hymn addresses the All-father in its opening verse.
entries.zh: 那首旧赞美诗在开头一节中呼告上帝。

entries.en: The neurologist discussed allachaesthesia without assuming that every misplaced sensation had the same cause.
entries.zh: 神经科医生讨论了异处感觉，但没有假定每一种位置错置的感觉都有相同原因。

entries.en: The case report described allachesthesia but left several examination results unreported.
entries.zh: 病例报告描述了异处感觉，但没有报告几项检查结果。

entries.en: She photographed the allachroic tiles from both ends of the gallery.
entries.zh: 她分别从展厅的两端拍摄了那些变色瓷砖。

entries.en: The old discussion of allaesthesia prompted her to consult the original case notes.
entries.zh: 那段关于异处感觉的旧讨论促使她查阅原始病例记录。

entries.en: The travel diary described a rainy afternoon in Allahabad without mentioning the date.
entries.zh: 那本旅行日记描写了在阿拉哈巴德度过的一个雨天下午，却没有注明日期。

entries.en: Allais brought a folding chair because the studio had nowhere comfortable to sit.
entries.zh: 阿莱带来了一把折叠椅，因为工作室里没有坐着舒服的地方。

entries.en: The mineralogist compared the allanite grains in the two thin sections.
entries.zh: 矿物学家比较了两片薄片中的褐帘石颗粒。

entries.en: The historian compared two accounts of allantiasis in the old hospital records.
entries.zh: 历史研究者比较了旧医院记录中关于腊肠中毒的两份记述。

entries.en: The embryology diagram showed the allantochorion in a different colour from the surrounding tissues.
entries.zh: 胚胎学示意图用不同于周围组织的颜色标示了尿囊绒毛膜。

entries.en: The lecturer paused to explain the allantoenteric connection in the historical anatomical drawing.
entries.zh: 讲师在那幅历史解剖图中的尿囊肠连接处停下来作了讲解。

entries.en: The student's account of allantogenesis relied on diagrams rather than on her own observations.
entries.zh: 学生对尿囊生成的描述依据的是示意图，而不是她自己的观察。

entries.en: The authors compared the allantoicase measurements but did not explain the difference between samples.
entries.zh: 作者比较了尿囊酸酶的测量结果，却没有解释样本之间的差异。

entries.en: The old embryology volume devoted a separate chapter to the Allantoidea.
entries.zh: 那本旧胚胎学著作专门用一章讨论羊膜动物类。

entries.en: The student identified an allantoidean from the embryological drawing in the old textbook.
entries.zh: 学生根据旧教科书中的胚胎学插图，辨认出了一种尿囊动物。

entries.meaningZh: 脐血管联胎〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The old anatomical atlas included an allantoido-angiopagus among its illustrated cases.
entries.zh: 那本旧解剖图谱所配图的病例中包括一个脐血管联胎病例。

entries.en: Her proposed study of allantoinase was postponed when the laboratory closed for repairs.
entries.zh: 实验室因维修关闭，她拟开展的尿囊素酶研究因此推迟了。

entries.en: The report discussed allantoinuria but left the source of the urinary allantoin unresolved.
entries.zh: 报告讨论了尿囊素尿，但没有解决尿中尿囊素来源的问题。

entries.en: The chemist compared two published analyses of allantoxaidine before revising her structural model.
entries.zh: 化学家在修订自己的结构模型之前，比较了两份已发表的尿囊毒素分析。

entries.meaningZh: 变质疗法；变换疗法〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The medical historian examined the evidence claimed for allassotherapy without recommending the treatment.
entries.zh: 医学史研究者考察了据称支持变质疗法的证据，没有推荐这种治疗。

entries.en: The conservator examined the edge of the Allautal panel without removing its aluminium covering.
entries.zh: 文物修复人员查看了纯铝包皮铝合金板的边缘，没有去掉其铝包覆层。

entries.en: The old entomological catalogue arranged its Alleculidae specimens by collection locality.
entries.zh: 那本旧昆虫学目录按采集地点排列朽木虫科标本。

entries.en: The postcard from Allegan arrived after the rest of the travel photographs.
entries.zh: 来自阿勒根的明信片比其余旅行照片晚到。

entries.meaningZh: 阿莱干尼生物地理带的
entries.en: The archivist compared the Alleghenian boundaries drawn on two old biogeographical maps.
entries.zh: 档案管理员比较了两幅旧生物地理图上所画的阿莱干尼生物地理带边界。

entries.en: The geneticist tracked the allel through three generations in the published pedigree.
entries.zh: 遗传学家在已发表的家系图中追踪了该等位基因在三代人中的传递情况。

entries.en: The seminar compared two early explanations of allelomorphism in inherited traits.
entries.zh: 研讨会比较了对遗传性状等位性的两种早期解释。

entries.en: The museum compared the old description of the allemontite specimen with its surviving photograph.
entries.zh: 博物馆把那件砷锑矿标本的旧描述与其留存的照片作了比较。

entries.en: The curator compared the Allenite tools in the workshop collection without testing their cutting performance.
entries.zh: 馆员比较了车间收藏中的阿列奈特碳化钨工具，没有测试它们的切削性能。

entries.en: The study compared allergenicity across the samples without assuming that all behaved alike.
entries.zh: 该研究比较了各样本的变应原性，并未假定所有样本的表现都一样。

entries.meaningZh: 变应素〔旧医学假说用语〕
entries.en: The medical historian questioned the evidence offered for allergin in the early theory.
entries.zh: 医学史研究者质疑了早期理论为变应素提出的证据。

entries.en: The review distinguished evidence of allergization from reports of symptoms alone.
entries.zh: 这篇综述把致敏作用的证据与单纯的症状报告区分开来。

entries.en: The archived case discussion considered allergodermia but did not establish a diagnosis.
entries.zh: 存档的病例讨论考虑了变应性皮病的可能性，但没有确立诊断。

entries.en: The new library catalogue made the older allergological journals easier to find.
entries.zh: 新的图书馆目录让较早的变应性学期刊更容易找到了。

entries.en: The old fungal catalogue grouped two isolates under Allescheria.
entries.zh: 那本旧真菌目录把两个分离株归入霉样真菌属。

entries.en: The examiner recorded the patient's description of allesthesia without assigning a cause.
entries.zh: 检查者记录了病人对异处感觉的描述，没有确定其原因。

entries.en: The analyst compared the allethrin measurements in the two archived reports.
entries.zh: 分析人员比较了两份存档报告中丙烯菊酯的测量结果。

entries.en: The alleyman retrieved the stray bowl before the next game began.
entries.zh: 下一场比赛开始前，滚球场工作人员捡回了那只偏离场地的滚球。

entries.en: Alleyne folded the letter before noticing a second page on the floor.
entries.zh: 阿莱恩把信折好后，才发现地板上还有第二页。

entries.en: The historian consulted an Alleynian magazine while researching the school's theatre building.
entries.zh: 历史研究者在研究该校剧院时，查阅了一本达尔威治学院的杂志。

entries.en: The poet's appeal to the Allfather appears only in the earlier version of the poem.
entries.zh: 诗人向上帝的祈求只出现在该诗较早的版本中。

entries.en: The old diary describes a family gathering at Allhallowmas but gives no calendar date.
entries.zh: 那本旧日记记述了诸圣节的一次家庭聚会，却没有给出日历日期。

entries.en: The reviewers asked how the allicin measurements had been checked before accepting the comparison.
entries.zh: 审稿人在接受这项比较之前，询问了蒜素的测量结果是如何核查的。

entries.en: The environmental review compared the reported allidochlor residues without recommending any application.
entries.zh: 环境评述比较了所报告的草毒死残留情况，没有推荐任何施用方式。

entries.en: The pharmacy student checked her alligation calculation before comparing the two mixture costs.
entries.zh: 药学学生先核查了自己的合剂求值计算，然后比较两种混合剂的成本。

entries.en: The old zoological catalogue grouped the illustrated specimens under Alligatorinae.
entries.zh: 那本旧动物学目录把图中标本归入钝吻鳄亚科。

entries.en: The revised chart separated the alliin measurements from the enzyme results.
entries.zh: 修订后的图表把蒜氨酸测量结果与酶的结果分开了。

entries.en: Their discussion of alliinase stopped short of proposing a treatment.
entries.zh: 他们对蒜氨酸酶的讨论没有进一步提出治疗方案。

entries.meaningZh: 蒜与洋芫荽合成丸剂〔旧制剂〕
entries.en: The historian questioned the claims in an old advertisement for Allimin tablets.
entries.zh: 历史研究者质疑一则旧广告中对蒜与洋芫荽合成丸剂Allimin所作的宣称。

entries.en: The editor asked whether the allinase results could be compared across the two studies.
entries.zh: 编辑询问，两项研究中的蒜氨酸酶结果能否相互比较。

entries.meaningZh: 阿利散廷〔蒜制剂商品名〕
entries.en: The reviewer separated the old Allisantin study's observations from its claims about the garlic preparation.
entries.zh: 审稿人把那项旧阿利散廷研究的观察结果与其对这种蒜制剂所作的宣称分开了。

entries.en: The chemistry student compared two published structural drawings of allithiamin before questioning the handwritten annotation.
entries.zh: 化学专业学生比较了两幅已经发表的蒜硫胺素结构图，然后对那条手写注释提出了质疑。

entries.en: The grant proposal compared earlier studies of allithiamine rather than claiming a new clinical benefit.
entries.zh: 这份经费申请比较了以往的蒜硫胺素研究，而没有声称发现了新的临床益处。

entries.en: The review questioned whether the two reports used comparable observations of alloaesthesia.
entries.zh: 这篇综述质疑，两份报告所采用的异处感觉观察是否具有可比性。

entries.en: The researchers disagreed about the interpretation of the alloalbumin pattern in the report.
entries.zh: 研究人员对报告中异白蛋白模式的解释意见不一。

entries.en: The case review discussed possible alloalbuminemia while acknowledging the limits of the available evidence.
entries.zh: 病例评述在讨论可能存在的异白蛋白血症时，承认了现有证据的局限。

entries.en: The historian compared two archived advertisements for allobarbital without endorsing their claims.
entries.zh: 历史研究者比较了两则存档的阿洛巴比妥广告，并未认可其宣传说法。

entries.en: The old physiology report discussed allobiosis without distinguishing environmental changes from changes within the organism.
entries.zh: 那份旧生理学报告讨论了反应性异常，却没有区分环境变化与生物体内部的变化。

entries.en: Her allocentric approach to the dispute considered the needs of everyone involved.
entries.zh: 她以异我中心的方式处理争端，考虑了所有相关者的需要。

entries.en: The old case report described allocheiria, but the later examination was not recorded.
entries.zh: 那份旧病例报告描述了对侧感觉，但没有记录后来的检查情况。

entries.en: The historical case discussion considered allochesthesia without claiming that the examination established its cause.
entries.zh: 历史病例讨论考虑了异处感觉，却没有声称检查已确定其原因。

entries.en: The historical case report discussed allochezia without explaining how the abnormal opening had developed.
entries.zh: 那份历史病例报告讨论了异位排粪，却没有解释那个异常开口是如何形成的。

entries.en: The old report compared allochiral responses recorded during two separate examinations.
entries.zh: 那份旧报告比较了两次不同检查中记录的对侧感觉反应。

entries.en: The lecturer discussed allochiria without treating every sensory error as evidence of it.
entries.zh: 讲师讨论了对侧感觉，但没有把每一种感觉错误都视为它的证据。

entries.en: The chemist reconsidered her interpretation of the allocholesterol spectrum after reading the earlier report.
entries.zh: 化学家读过较早的报告后，重新考虑了自己对别胆甾醇光谱的解释。

entries.en: The collector compared the allochroite specimen with the drawing in the old mineral catalogue.
entries.zh: 收藏者把那件粒榴石标本与旧矿物目录中的图画作了比较。

entries.en: The case history described allochromasia without identifying the cause of the change in hair colour.
entries.zh: 病史描述了毛发变色，却没有确定颜色变化的原因。

entries.en: The curator compared the colours of the allochromatic mineral specimens under the same light.
entries.zh: 馆员在同样的光照下比较了这些因杂质而呈色的矿物标本的颜色。

entries.en: The chemist questioned the proposed identification of allocimenol after comparing the published alcohol structures.
entries.zh: 化学家比较了已经发表的醇类结构后，对将该物质认定为别罗勒烯醇的提议提出了质疑。

entries.en: The historical review compared two published studies of alloclamide without endorsing their conclusions.
entries.zh: 这篇历史评述比较了两项已发表的阿洛拉胺研究，并未认可其结论。

entries.en: The curator placed the alloclasite specimen beside a photograph of its polished section.
entries.zh: 馆员把那件杂硫铋砷钴矿标本与其抛光切面的照片放在一起。

entries.en: The old discussion of allococaine focused on competing structural drawings, not on methods of production.
entries.zh: 那段关于别可卡因的旧讨论关注的是相互竞争的结构图，而非生产方法。

entries.en: The old paper compared two allocolloid systems without resolving the difference between their structures.
entries.zh: 那篇旧论文比较了两个同素异形胶体体系，却没有解决其结构差异的问题。

entries.en: The anatomist shaded the allocortex on the brain diagram before adding the remaining labels.
entries.zh: 解剖学家在脑示意图上给不均皮质涂上阴影，然后添上其余标注。

entries.en: The analyst questioned whether the spectrum justified the report's identification of allocortol.
entries.zh: 分析人员质疑，这份光谱是否足以支持报告将该物质认定为别皮甾五醇。

entries.en: The researcher compared the allocortolone spectra in the two supplementary reports.
entries.zh: 研究者比较了两份补充报告中的别皮甾酮四醇光谱。

entries.en: The old illustration represented the gland as allocrine, but the notes supplied little evidence.
entries.zh: 那幅旧插图把该腺体描绘为具有多种分泌功能，但附注提供的证据很少。

entries.en: Her model of allocryptopine was revised after she checked the published structural analysis.
entries.zh: 她核查了已发表的结构分析后，修订了自己的别隐品碱模型。

entries.en: The conservator requested an analysis of the allocyanine in the old dye collection.
entries.zh: 文物修复人员要求分析那批旧染料收藏中的别菁。

entries.en: The reviewer compared the allocymarin measurements with the results for the other glycosides.
entries.zh: 审稿人把异加拿大麻甙的测量结果与其他苷类的结果作了比较。

entries.en: The zoologist compared the Allodermanyssus specimens in two archived collections.
entries.zh: 动物学家比较了两批存档收藏中的异刺皮螨属标本。

entries.en: The proposed model contained an allodimer, but the authors had not yet tested that arrangement.
entries.zh: 所提出的模型包含一个异二聚物，但作者尚未检验这种排列方式。

entries.en: The botanist compared the chromosomes of the allodiploid plants in the illustration.
entries.zh: 植物学家比较了插图中那些异源二倍体植物的染色体。

entries.en: The historical classification placed several of the illustrated specimens in Alloeocoela.
entries.zh: 那套历史分类把图中若干标本归入异腔目。

entries.meaningZh: 变化〔此处指病情变化，旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The physician's old notes recorded alloeosis but left the direction of the change unclear.
entries.zh: 那位医生的旧记录记载了病情变化，却没有说清变化的方向。

entries.en: The neurologist compared the two descriptions of alloesthesia before examining the original records.
entries.zh: 神经科医生先比较了对异处感觉的两种描述，然后查看原始记录。

entries.en: The chemist compared published structural drawings of alloevodione and evodione before revising her presentation.
entries.zh: 化学家先比较了已经发表的别吴茱萸酮和吴茱萸酮结构图，然后修改自己的演示材料。

entries.en: The zoologist compared the Allogromiidae drawings with the specimens described in the accompanying notes.
entries.zh: 动物学家把异网足虫科的图画与附注所描述的标本作了比较。

entries.en: The student compared two structural drawings of allohydroxylysine before discussing their stereochemistry.
entries.zh: 学生先比较了两幅别羟基赖氨酸结构图，然后讨论其立体化学。

entries.en: The reviewer asked how the allohydroxyproline measurements had been distinguished from the other results.
entries.zh: 审稿人询问，研究人员如何把别羟脯氨酸的测量结果与其他结果区分开来。

entries.en: The review found that the two reports presented different interpretations of the alloimperatorin spectrum.
entries.zh: 这篇综述发现，两份报告对别前胡精光谱的解释不同。

entries.en: The analyst questioned whether the reported peak had been correctly assigned to alloisoleucine.
entries.zh: 分析人员质疑，报告中的那个峰是否被正确归属于别异亮氨酸。

entries.en: The tutor used two molecular drawings to explain the alloisomerism discussed in the old paper.
entries.zh: 导师用两幅分子结构图解释了那篇旧论文所讨论的立体异构现象。

entries.en: The historian compared two old accounts of allokeratoplasty without assessing their reported clinical success.
entries.zh: 历史研究者比较了两份关于异质角膜成形术的旧记述，没有评价其所报告的临床成功情况。

entries.en: The early physiologist distinguished allokinetic movements from those initiated voluntarily.
entries.zh: 那位早期生理学家把被动运动与主动发起的运动区分开来。

entries.en: The mycologist compared the Allomyces drawings before returning the old journal to the library.
entries.zh: 真菌学家比较了那些异水霉属图画，然后把旧期刊还给图书馆。

entries.meaningZh: 受外部刺激节制的〔旧心理学用语〕
entries.en: The old psychology text contrasted allonomous activity with processes that continued without external stimulation.
entries.zh: 那本旧心理学教材把受外部刺激节制的活动与没有外部刺激仍然持续的过程作了对比。

entries.en: The student's model of alloocimene placed the double bonds differently from the published drawing.
entries.zh: 学生的别罗勒烯模型所标示的双键位置与已发表的结构图不同。

entries.en: The novel's allopath listens to the patient's doubts before answering the visiting homeopath.
entries.zh: 小说中的对抗疗法医生先听了病人的疑虑，然后回答来访的顺势疗法医生。

entries.en: An allopathist and a homeopath exchange letters in the historical play.
entries.zh: 在这部历史剧中，一位对抗疗法医生与一位顺势疗法医生互通信件。

entries.en: The chemist compared published diagrams of alloperiplocymarin and periplocymarin before revising her lecture notes.
entries.zh: 化学家先比较了已经发表的别杠柳苷和杠柳苷结构图，然后修改自己的讲义。

entries.en: The chemistry class compared the drawn structures of allophanamide and urea.
entries.zh: 化学课上，学生比较了图中双缩脲与尿素的结构。

entries.en: She found no structural drawing of the allophanate salt in the old chemistry review.
entries.zh: 她在那篇旧化学综述中没有找到脲基甲酸盐的结构图。

entries.en: The geologist compared the allophane measurements from two soil profiles.
entries.zh: 地质学家比较了两个土壤剖面的水铝英石测量结果。

entries.en: The biologist outlined an allophore in the drawing of pigmented skin.
entries.zh: 生物学家在有色素的皮肤图中描出了一枚红色素细胞的轮廓。

entries.en: The researchers checked the allophycocyanin results against the control before revising the figure.
entries.zh: 研究人员先根据对照核查了别藻蓝蛋白的结果，然后修改图表。

entries.en: The historical report discussed alloplasia without establishing how the tissue change had begun.
entries.zh: 那份历史报告讨论了发育异常，但没有确定组织变化是如何开始的。

entries.en: The old cell diagram distinguished alloplasmatic structures from the surrounding protoplasm.
entries.zh: 那幅旧细胞图把异质结构与周围的原生质区分开来。

entries.en: The surgical historian examined the drawing of an alloplast described in an old case report.
entries.zh: 外科史研究者查看了一份旧病例报告中所述异质移植物的图示。

entries.en: The article compared two historical alloplastic techniques without recommending either for current use.
entries.zh: 文章比较了两种历史上的异质成形技术，并未推荐其中任何一种供现在使用。

entries.en: The seminar considered how accounts of alloplasty had changed between successive editions of the textbook.
entries.zh: 研讨会考察了教科书不同版本对异质成形术的记述有何变化。

entries.en: The illustration contrasted the alloploid plants with the other specimens in the study.
entries.zh: 插图把研究中的异源倍体植物与其他标本作了对比。

entries.en: The authors discussed alloploidy without assuming that it explained every difference between the plants.
entries.zh: 作者讨论了异源倍性，但没有假定它能解释这些植物之间的每一种差异。

entries.en: The proposed breeding study would compare allopolyploid plants with their parental lines.
entries.zh: 拟议的育种研究将把异源多倍体植物与其亲本品系作比较。

entries.en: The analyst rechecked the allopregnandiol results after finding a discrepancy between the two reports.
entries.zh: 分析人员发现两份报告不一致后，重新核查了别孕烷二醇的结果。

entries.en: The researcher compared two proposed structures for allopregnenolone without making a clinical claim.
entries.zh: 研究者比较了对别孕烯醇酮提出的两种结构，没有作出临床方面的断言。

entries.en: The tutor compared the allopseudococaine model with the other stereoisomer models during the chemistry seminar.
entries.zh: 在化学研讨课上，导师把别拟可卡因模型与其他立体异构体模型作了比较。

entries.en: The old report described an allorhythmic pulse but did not identify its cause.
entries.zh: 那份旧报告描述了节律异常的脉搏，却没有确定其原因。

entries.en: The model of allosterism was revised after the authors reconsidered their earlier measurements.
entries.zh: 作者重新考虑了先前的测量结果，随后修订了变构模型。

entries.en: The geneticist asked whether the chromosome drawings supplied sufficient evidence of allosyndesis.
entries.zh: 遗传学家问，那些染色体图画是否提供了足够的异质接合证据。

entries.en: Her interpretation of the allotetrahydrocortisone data changed after she examined the original spectra.
entries.zh: 她查看了原始光谱后，改变了对别四氢可的松数据的解释。

entries.en: The historical play contrasts arguments for allotherapy with those offered by a visiting homeopath.
entries.zh: 这部历史剧把支持对抗疗法的论据与一位来访的顺势疗法医生提出的论据作了对比。

entries.en: The old fossil catalogue placed the specimen in Allotheria without providing a detailed drawing.
entries.zh: 那本旧化石目录把该标本归入异兽亚纲，却没有提供详细图画。

entries.en: The old diagram contrasted an allotherm with an animal that maintained a steadier body temperature.
entries.zh: 那幅旧示意图把一种变温动物与一种体温更稳定的动物作了对比。

entries.en: The geologist marked the allothigene grains on the thin-section drawing.
entries.zh: 地质学家在薄片图中标出了那些他生颗粒。

entries.en: The geologist outlined the allothimorphic grains before comparing their preserved boundaries with the surrounding material.
entries.zh: 地质学家先描出了那些变生颗粒的轮廓，然后把其保留的边界与周围物质作了比较。

entries.en: The tutor asked the student to compare the drawn stereochemistry of allothreonine and threonine.
entries.zh: 导师让学生比较图中别苏氨酸与苏氨酸的立体化学结构。

entries.en: The researchers questioned whether the proposed allotopic expression would restore the missing function.
entries.zh: 研究人员质疑，拟议的异位表达能否恢复缺失的功能。

entries.en: The historian found the old claim about allotoxin unconvincing and sought the original experimental records.
entries.zh: 历史研究者认为旧文献中关于抗异毒素的说法缺乏说服力，因而寻找原始实验记录。

entries.en: The review compared historical accounts of allotransplantation without offering surgical instructions.
entries.zh: 这篇综述比较了关于异体移植术的历史记述，没有提供外科操作指引。

entries.en: The case history mentioned allotriogeusia but did not describe which tastes had changed.
entries.zh: 病史提到了味觉异常，却没有描述哪些味觉发生了变化。

entries.en: Her account of allotriogeustia was incomplete, so the editor requested the original clinical notes.
entries.zh: 她对味觉异常的记述并不完整，因此编辑要求提供原始临床记录。

entries.en: The petrographer marked the allotriomorphic grains in the thin-section drawing.
entries.zh: 岩相学家在薄片图中标出了那些他形矿物颗粒。

entries.en: The case discussion raised allotriophagy as a possibility rather than as a confirmed diagnosis.
entries.zh: 病例讨论把异食癖作为一种可能性提出，而不是已确诊的疾病。

entries.en: The patient's account of allotriosmia differed between the two archived interviews.
entries.zh: 病人在两次存档访谈中对嗅觉异常的描述有所不同。

entries.en: The old case notes described allotriuria but did not identify the foreign material in the urine.
entries.zh: 那些旧病例记录描述了异尿症，却没有确定尿液中的异物是什么。

entries.meaningZh: 氨基四氧嘧啶〔旧化学用语〕
entries.en: The chemist compared two historical descriptions of alloxamide before revising her structural drawing.
entries.zh: 化学家先比较了对氨基四氧嘧啶的两种历史记述，然后修改自己的结构图。

entries.en: The researchers disputed the interpretation of the alloxan measurements, not the existence of the samples.
entries.zh: 研究人员争论的是阿脲测量结果的解释，而不是样本是否存在。

entries.en: The revised analysis of the old experiment separated the alloxanthin result from the result for alloxan.
entries.zh: 对那项旧实验的修订分析把双阿脲的结果与阿脲的结果分开了。

entries.en: The chemist compared two published structural drawings of alloxantin before preparing her lecture.
entries.zh: 化学家在备课之前比较了两幅已经发表的双阿脲结构图。

entries.en: The chemistry tutor compared two structural drawings of alloxazine before discussing the disputed interpretation.
entries.zh: 化学导师在讨论那种有争议的解释之前，比较了两幅咯嗪结构图。

entries.en: The old paper's account of alloxin was incomplete, so the historian examined its cited analyses.
entries.zh: 那篇旧论文对核嘌呤的记述不完整，因此历史研究者查看了它引用的分析资料。

entries.en: The historical case report discussed alloxuria but did not explain the urinary findings.
entries.zh: 那份历史病例报告讨论了嘌呤碱尿，却没有解释尿液检查结果。
